mentions.claim_text: Camera and seating chatter before the session begins.
mentions.quote: move that camera back
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: housekeeping, no claim.

mentions.claim_text: He restates seeing great persecution coming to Canada, and says people are fed up.
mentions.quote: I saw all the persecution coming to Canada
mentions.falsify_match: Organised persecution of Christians in Canada.

mentions.claim_text: Taking communion he was shown New Year's Eve, with a warning over major American cities.
mentions.quote: I was seeing over into New Year's Eve
mentions.falsify_match: An incident in a major American city over New Year.

mentions.claim_text: Hold fast, church, because a shaking is coming to America.
mentions.quote: there's a shaking coming to America
mentions.falsify_match: A national event he would call a shaking.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: no threshold given.

mentions.claim_text: They are casing Six Flags Over Texas in the Arlington area, mega churches and the Vatican, with Salt Lake City named alongside.
mentions.quote: I saw them casing Six Flags Over Texas
mentions.falsify_match: An attack or foiled plot at a theme park, mega church or the Vatican.

mentions.claim_text: A man with a military haircut, black trench coat and dark glasses walking in Europe, and a woman said to have lost her influence but not all of it.
mentions.quote: She's lost her influence, but she hasn't lost it all
mentions.falsify_match: A named woman formerly close to the Obama administration returns to visible influence.

mentions.claim_text: Her influence rated two out of ten now against ten when she was with Obama, so she is in the background but not gone.
mentions.quote: her scale was she still she has lost a lot of influence
mentions.falsify_match: That figure re-emerges publicly.
mentions.falsify_miss: She stays out of public influence.

mentions.claim_text: Things shown about Germany, with Putin holding meetings and visibly angry.
mentions.quote: even about Germany and things that are coming
mentions.falsify_match: A German-Russian confrontation of consequence.

mentions.claim_text: He corrects himself: the casing was of Six Flags rather than Warner Brothers.
mentions.quote: Oh, no, Warner Brothers it was Six Flags
mentions.falsify_match: A plot against that named park.

mentions.claim_text: He saw the Father standing in a bright light looking at the coast, and calls the church to put its armour on and win the lost.
mentions.quote: I SAW A BIG BRIGHT LIGHT AND HE WAS LOOKING AT THE coast
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a call to the audience with no outcome.

mentions.claim_text: Branson, Missouri named again as a hot spot, with places differing one from another.
mentions.quote: Branson, Missouri is a hot spot
mentions.falsify_match: Branson becomes a recognised centre of revival or relocation.

mentions.claim_text: Japan shaking again, with the shape of the land described as he works out what he is seeing.
mentions.quote: I see a Japan shaking shaking shaking again
mentions.falsify_match: A major earthquake in Japan.

mentions.claim_text: A flag with yellow stars seen crumpled and torn, one half attached to North Korea, which he cannot tell is Russian or Chinese.
mentions.quote: it's being torn and it's it's attached to North Kor
mentions.falsify_match: A rupture in the Chinese or Russian state tied to North Korea.

mentions.claim_text: A stronghold of walls and rock seen toward China to the west.
mentions.quote: I see a stronghold of of rock a rock over here towards China
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an uninterpreted image with no event attached.

mentions.claim_text: A quick work of shaking in the church and an awakening, with America shaken from the core of its foundation.
mentions.quote: going to be shaken from the very core of the foundation
mentions.falsify_match: A national shaking followed by a recognised awakening.

mentions.claim_text: He says supernatural things will be a witness, described as something people could film but might get in trouble for.
mentions.quote: He said it's going to be a witness
mentions.falsify_match: Documented supernatural events circulating publicly.

mentions.claim_text: He announces that they will go back over what was seen and revealed the previous day.
mentions.quote: we're going to go over what we saw yesterday
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a preamble.

mentions.claim_text: A wheel spinning over America, and over Cuba a black and yellow nuclear or biological hazard symbol on a black fifty gallon drum.
mentions.quote: black and yellow hazard on a black 50-
mentions.falsify_match: A chemical, biological or radiological device staged in drums.

mentions.claim_text: A strong caution over Venezuela and what its government will do, with the oil rigs recalled.
mentions.quote: I have such a caution
mentions.falsify_match: An escalation involving Venezuelan oil infrastructure.

mentions.claim_text: The Venezuelan leader will be like Gaddafi and is seen removed before the escalation appears on television, which he says regular viewers can validate.
mentions.quote: I saw him being removed before any of this escalation is on TV
mentions.falsify_match: He is removed from power.

mentions.claim_text: Revival among the Venezuelan people on the heels of the overthrow of the regime and the drug lords, with the slate cleaned.
mentions.quote: I saw revival on the heels of the the uh the uh overthrowing
mentions.falsify_match: A reported religious revival in Venezuela after the regime falls.

mentions.claim_text: Attacks seen in New York again, with the Times Square ball going down and planned attacks on Times Square at New Year's Eve.
mentions.quote: I see the Times Square ball going down
mentions.falsify_match: An attack at the Times Square New Year celebration.

mentions.claim_text: He says the focus is not only Jewish communities and culture but Christians too.
mentions.quote: It's not just about them. It's about the Christian
mentions.falsify_match: Attacks extend from Jewish to Christian targets.

mentions.claim_text: Europe about to unravel, with a black swan seen swimming down a river in France.
mentions.quote: I see the black swan swimming down a river
mentions.falsify_match: An unforeseen shock originating in France or Europe.

mentions.claim_text: Praying in tongues, after which he says the tie goes to Israel.
mentions.quote: The tie goes to here to to to Israel
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an untranslated utterance with an unexplained conclusion.

mentions.claim_text: The Ukrainian president goes home and a proxy government is installed, at a forked road leading either to major war or to peace.
mentions.quote: I saw um uh Zelensky go home
mentions.falsify_match: He leaves office and a proxy government follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: He stays or is replaced by an independent government.

mentions.claim_text: Russia is working to a fifty year plan to get the whole old empire back rather than to one American administration.
mentions.quote: We want all of our old empire back
mentions.falsify_match: Russian moves beyond Ukraine toward former Soviet territory.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks the 5,650 people praying with them in the middle of the night.
mentions.quote: all 5,650 of you
mentions.falsify_match: A concurrent viewer figure, checkable against the stream.

mentions.claim_text: He says souls are what matter most, against other measures of success.
mentions.quote: What you always talking about? Souls
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement of priorities.

mentions.claim_text: He says what he wants is to stand before Jesus and be told he brought a hundred million people in.
mentions.quote: You got a 100 million people
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an aspiration with no measure.

mentions.claim_text: He asks for the clip of what he said on a previous New Year's Eve about what was coming to be played.
mentions.quote: play the clip of what I said at on New Year's Eve
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an archive replay announced.

mentions.claim_text: A major event was said to be coming in Toronto and across Canada, with Australia and England named too.
mentions.quote: a major event was going to take place in in Toronto
mentions.falsify_match: A major incident in Toronto or the other named countries.

mentions.claim_text: Persecution arriving in Canada as told, with an article cited, and an uprising seen next.
mentions.quote: the persecution coming just like the Lord told us in Canada
mentions.falsify_match: Canadian legislation restricting religious speech, followed by unrest.

mentions.claim_text: Pressing the olives in Canada against freedom of speech, restating the word that people would not be able to say what they believe.
mentions.quote: Great persecution is coming to Canada against freedom of speech
mentions.falsify_match: Speech restrictions in Canada reaching religious expression.

mentions.claim_text: People start transitioning and moving to the heartland in abundance, which he lists as Oklahoma, Kansas, Texas and Arkansas.
mentions.quote: People are going to start to transition and move to the heartland
mentions.falsify_match: Net migration into those states rises markedly.

mentions.claim_text: A stern warning that controlling the weather will cost lives, alongside seeing Italy split again and Japan.
mentions.quote: controlling the weather something about it will it will cost you your life
mentions.falsify_match: Deaths attributed to deliberate weather modification.

mentions.claim_text: They are regrouping at the tip and a major event is about to take place with Israel, with Turkey and Syria becoming friends.
mentions.quote: I saw Turkey and Syria becoming buddi
mentions.falsify_match: A Turkey-Syria alignment against Israel.

mentions.claim_text: They locate Gaza on the map and he says what he saw was more toward the other side.
mentions.quote: the Gaza is where all this stuff is going on
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: map talk locating an earlier vision.

mentions.claim_text: The world will say out with the old, in with the new, and that prophetic voices are not needed, in New York Times and Washington Post headlines.
mentions.quote: You don't need prophetic voices. Out with out with the old
mentions.falsify_match: Headlines in those papers dismissing prophetic voices.

mentions.claim_text: He matches a commentator saying the grid would take forever to restore to his own vision of over three weeks without power in major cities.
mentions.quote: I saw three weeks, over three weeks, the power was out
mentions.falsify_match: An outage of about three weeks in major American cities.

mentions.claim_text: He describes his head and ears burning as he began seeing in the spirit for the first time, and running out afterwards.
mentions.quote: I started seeing the spirit for the first time
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a personal account of an experience.

mentions.claim_text: A massive mass grave full of body bags after water treatment plants were poisoned, with over 23 million dead.
mentions.quote: there's over 23 million people that passed away
mentions.falsify_match: Mass casualties from deliberate contamination of water supplies.

mentions.claim_text: Only Jesus Christ will change the nation, not Buddha, not Muhammad and not the president.
mentions.quote: the only thing that's ever going to change this nation is Jesus Christ
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a doctrinal statement.

mentions.claim_text: The royals seen as demonic lizard figures keeping it in the bloodline, with the same among the Saudis, in South America and in Asia.
mentions.quote: I saw king the king demonic lizard people
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a spiritual characterisation of dynasties.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether there are active or dormant volcanoes in the Caribbean, naming St Martin and St Thomas.
mentions.quote: Is there active volcanoes in the Caribbean?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a question asked on air.
